entries.text: 只要是和寶可夢在一起，\n任誰都是寶可夢訓練家！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_23

entries.text: 我們寶可夢訓練家\n就是要透過對戰讓寶可夢變強！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_24

entries.text: 唉～真是在吊我胃口！\n我快要等不及了！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_02

entries.text: 太好了！我好期待呢！\n這次我要用的寶可夢是……[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_03

entries.text: 妮莫同學。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0090_head_teacher_01

entries.text: 這是[VAR 0x0100(0000)]同學第一次！\n……的寶可夢對戰喔。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0090_head_teacher_02

entries.text: 啊哈哈……\n我一不小心就要派出\r\n平常習慣的寶可夢了。[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_04

entries.text: 嗯～既然如此……\n那就讓剛才的孩子首次上場吧！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_05

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]！\n我們來打一場收穫多多的對戰吧！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_06

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳第一次對戰竟然就能打贏，\n真是比我想的還要厲害耶！\r\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳一定會變得更強的！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_07a

entries.text: 第一次對戰就能有這樣的表現，\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳很有當訓練家的天分喔！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_07b

entries.text: 我還想試試不同的戰術。\n我們再打一場吧～！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_08

entries.text: 啊，不好意思。\n我興奮得忍不住就……[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_09

entries.text: 沒關係的
entries.label: common_0090_select_01

entries.text: 下次再戰吧
entries.label: common_0090_select_02

entries.text: 嗯，一定要再對戰！\n我們說定囉！！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_11b

entries.text: 兩位才剛認識，\n就已經變得很要好了呢。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0090_head_teacher_04

entries.text: 請妳這位冠軍\n多教[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]他她一些事情吧。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0090_head_teacher_05

entries.text: 那就得裝那個App！\c\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳有手機嗎？\n讓我稍微弄一下。[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_14

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]可以用手機洛托姆\n打開[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]寶可夢圖鑑[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]了！
entries.label: common_0090_system_01

entries.text: 寶可夢圖鑑會幫[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳自動登錄\n自己捕捉到的寶可夢。[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_15

entries.text: 如果是寶可夢訓練家，就一定要多留意！\n這是我們的班導，吉尼亞老師做的\r\n很方便的App喔！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_16

entries.text: 在我那個年代，說到圖鑑\n可是得手寫在筆記本上的呢。\r\n現在的時代真是令人振奮啊。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0090_head_teacher_06

entries.text: 手寫圖鑑未免也太辛苦了！\n我根本沒辦法想像！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_17

entries.text: 呵呵……\n我想也是。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0090_head_teacher_07

entries.text: 不過，即使時代變了，\n與寶可夢相遇的那份美好感動\r\n是不論何時都不會褪色的。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0090_head_teacher_08

entries.text: 我相信與寶可夢的相遇越多，\n為兩位帶來的成長也就會越大。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0090_head_teacher_09

entries.text: 請以完成圖鑑為目標，\n好好加油吧。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0090_head_teacher_10

entries.text: 我還有事要與\n妮莫同學的家人談談。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0090_head_teacher_11

entries.text: 要是妮莫同學妳能夠\n帶[VAR 0x0100(0000)]同學到學院，\r\n我會非常感激……[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0090_head_teacher_12

entries.text: 那當然了！\n請包在我身上！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_18

entries.text: 我知道妳很可靠的。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0090_head_teacher_13

entries.text: 那麼，\n你跟我一起來吧。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0090_head_teacher_14

entries.text: 耶喵。
entries.label: common_0090_grass_01

entries.text: 呆呃～
entries.label: common_0090_fire_01

entries.text: 潤！
entries.label: common_0090_water_01

entries.text: 也許不只是對戰，我應該\n要稍微加把勁填圖鑑才是。[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_19

entries.text: 在去學校之前，我先教[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳吧！\n跟我來～！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_22

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]同學，\n要平平安安上學喔。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0090_head_teacher_15
